Explain why calling a conversion factor a "factor of one" is justified or is misleading.

`r devoirs::devoirs_text("RQ-units-flavor")`

<!-- Opening answer: Reading-questions-3mc -->
::: {.callout-tip collapse=true `r devoirs:::answer_style()`}
## Answer

Time: second, minute, hour, year, decade, femtosecond

Length: meter, cm, parsec, light-year, mile

Temperature: degree F, degree C, degree Kelvin, degree Rankine, and more obscurely, Réaumur

Mass: gram, kilogram, (metric) tonne, slug, microgram

Money: USD, Euro, Remnimbi, Yuan, Pound, Peso, Franc, Boliviano
